creative_premise: A browser observatory containing three abstract mechanical organisms that reveal behavior through movement, stillness, and single-gesture memory.

claims: no external libraries, assets, fonts, analytics, payment, or conversion logic
reduced-motion and textual accessibility paths are present
device pixel ratio is capped and rendering uses one canvas loop

independence_boundary: The work has its own identity, purpose, interaction grammar, and future hosting target and must not deploy through the Mirror Cartographer Vercel production project.
